proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5023 chādya section 1 explicitly gives Braj chajjo/chājo veranda/roof in the addenda, alongside Nepali chajjā roof/balcony. Mewari chajo roof matches this j branch, not section 2 chādiya. Exact survey form chajo is preserved.

records.Source: varghese-john-samuel2009malvi[Appendix B, printed p. 70, item 27, Sondhwadi-Malvi-Adakhedi]

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12311 śamba gives Gujarati sā̃belũ/sāmelũ wooden pestle. Mewari hamela pestle is compared with that whole regional noun; initial h versus s and its ending are retained as regional comparative qualifications, with intra-Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact survey form hamela is preserved.

records.Source: varghese-john-samuel2009malvi[Appendix B, printed p. 73, item 32, Rajwadi-Malvi-Bhunyakhedi]
